delete from stg.csi_service_order_status;

with sro_stat as
(SELECT 
	site_ref
	,trim(sro_num) sro_num
	,seq
	,stat_code
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(stat_date as datetime)) stat_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(CreateDate as datetime)) CreateDate
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(RecordDate as datetime)) RecordDate
FROM raw.csi_fs_sro_stat_mst)
insert into stg.csi_service_order_status
select 
	site_ref
	,sro_num
	,seq
	,stat_code
	,cast(stat_date as date) stat_date
	,cast(CreateDate as date) CreateDate
	,cast(RecordDate as date) RecordDate
from sro_stat ;
